inputs.goal: an impossible-travel alert, with 30 days of auth logs

steps: Decompose the goal into actionable sub-tasks
Gather authentication logs for the past 30 days
Analyze log data to identify anomalies or patterns
Synthesize findings related to impossible travel alerts
Compile and format results as supporting evidence
Construct final conclusion based on synthesized data
